title: SAGE: A Stabilize-Assess-Govern-Enforce Framework for Deployment-Oriented Evaluation of LLM-Based Autonomous Agents
creator: Hamdan M.
normalized_title: sage a stabilize assess govern enforce framework for deployment oriented evaluation of llm based autonomous agents
V60_REASON: Models autonomous-agent execution as a feedback-driven non-stationary process; runtime monitors detect observation/progress/context instability and an Adaptive Stability Controller dispatches bounded interventions including re-anchoring, replanning, schema-validated retry, compression and escalation. Controlled experiments test recovery from mid-execution derailments. This directly addresses preserving/restoring action validity across execution state changes.
